title: clinopodium chinense var. parviflorum
intro: Clinopodium chinense var. parviflorum, commonly known as Small-flowered Chinese Clinopodium, is a variety of the Clinopodium chinense plant. This plant is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) and is native to China. Clinopodium chinense var. parviflorum has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as expectorant, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
